The Lab 300: 2026 Half PPR Rankings

Updated September 5th, 2026

Jingles Labs
Sep 5
∙
Paid
 
READ IN APP
 

Four months of film, numbers and way too much tinkering later, The Lab 300 is complete.

These aren’t just rankings of who I think the best players are. I’m looking at talent, opportunity, upside, risk, situation, ADP and what I believe each player can actually return at their draft cost.

I’ve spent the offseason watching film, digging through the numbers and adjusting this board as roles, depth charts and situations have changed.

This is my final preseason Half PPR draft board for 2026, but the fantasy coverage is just getting started.

Once the season kicks off, I’ll be posting updated weekly rankings, waiver wire targets, Start/Sit decisions, Love/Hate lists, DFS plays, player analysis and plenty more throughout the season.

PPR and Standard versions of The Lab 300 are coming next.

The board is yours. Do with it what you will. 🧪
